---
title: "U.S. States"
subtitle: "A map of U.S. states overlaid with computed centroids."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [U.S. States](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/us-state-map.html)
from the mosaic/vgplot example gallery (adapted from an [Observable
Plot example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-state-centroids)).
Requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "U.S. States",
    description = "A map of U.S. states overlaid with computed centroids. Requires the DuckDB `spatial` extension.",
    credit = "Adapted from an [Observable Plot example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-state-centroids)."
  ) |>
  vg_data(
    name = "states",
    type = "spatial",
    file = vg_data_url("us-counties-10m.json"),
    layer = "states"
  ) |>
  vg_mark_geo(
    data_from = "states",
    stroke = "currentColor",
    stroke_width = 1
  ) |>
  vg_mark_dot(
    data_from = "states",
    x = ~ vg_centroid_x(geom),
    y = ~ vg_centroid_y(geom),
    r = 2,
    fill = "steelblue",
    tip = TRUE,
    title = ~name
  ) |>
  vg_plot(margin = 0, projection_type = "albers")

vg_render(spec)
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/us-state-map.html) exactly,
aside from `data.states.file` (`vg_data_url()` vs. a relative path) and
object key order.
:::
